description: We are a team of students passionate about space exploration, technology, and education. Through the NASA Space Apps Challenge, we aim to develop engaging tools that inspire and prepare the next generation of astronauts. Our goal is to make space learning interactive, accessible, and exciting for young learners.
summary:
Red Horizon is a 2D Mars survival game that puts players in control of a stranded Martian outpost, challenging them to survive for 120 Martian days until rescue arrives. Players must carefully manage three essential resources: oxygen, food and energy. They can build and upgrade structures such as greenhouses, oxygen generators and solar panels to maintain their supplies and keep the outpost operational.

The game incorporates realworld solar energy measurements from NASA's InSight Mars mission to influence solar panel energy generation as it also includes environmental disasters such as dust storms and solar eclipses introduce additional challenges. A quiz and knowledge based reward system also encourages players to engage with space related learning as they earn "WISDOM" points to build machines for their survival.

Red Horizon addresses the challenge by turning the complex resource management decisions involved in sustaining an extraterrestrial outpost into an interactive experience. It aims to make space exploration, engineering trade offs and STEM learning more engaging and accessible to the youth of tomorrow.
details:
Red Horizon is a 2D Mars survival game where players must survive 120 Martian days after being stranded at an outpost. Players manage oxygen, food and energy by building and upgrading greenhouses, oxygen generators and solar panels. The quizz in the game reward players with Wisdom points to obtain structures, while dust storms and solar eclipses create additional challenges. And the buildings are having a capped durability which reduces and destroys them over time.

The game makes the challenges of sustaining human life on Mars interactive and engaging. It develops strategic thinking, problem solving and resource management skills while introducing players to space exploration and STEM concepts.

Developed using Unity and C#, the game uses TextMeshPro for the interface. It also integrates NASA's InSight solar array dataset to adjust solar panel energy generation based on real world measurements.

Red Horizon combines survival mechanics, educational quizzes and real scientific data. Its Wisdom reward system connects learning directly to gameplay, while changing solar availability and environmental disasters require players to adapt their strategies.

We as a team focused upon considering scientific relevance, accessibility, gameplay balance and educational value, aiming to create an enjoyable experience that realistically introduces the engineering and resource management challenges of establishing a sustainable Martian outpost.
